anti_commodity_copy_rewrite.property_overview_150_words: Nestled in the heart of Kenton-on-Sea, The House Quarters offers a vibrant coastal escape where luxury meets authentic Eastern Cape charm. Experience our lively outdoor dining terrace, a social hub for delicious cuisine and engaging conversations. Our spacious, beautifully appointed rooms provide a tranquil sanctuary after a day of exploring pristine beaches and dramatic dunes. With friendly, attentive staff and a welcoming atmosphere, we are the ideal base for couples and foodies seeking adventure and relaxation. Discover a true local gem, loved by those who appreciate genuine hospitality and a connection to the stunning Sunshine Coast.
